faq.title: A few things to know.
faq.question1: Do I need a Strava account?
faq.answer1: You need a Strava account for activity data. Create a PacePilot account with your email, then link Strava inside the app.
faq.question2: What can I see in PacePilot?
faq.answer2: Your daily workout, weekly training plan, progress analytics, activity history and goals — connected through one running-focused workspace.
faq.question3: Are these results from real athletes?
faq.answer3: The workouts, charts and records shown on this page are illustrative product examples, not performance claims or expected results.

consent.title: Analytics
consent.message: We use Google Analytics to see which screens help your training. Only the screen name and anonymous interaction counts are sent — never your account details or your activities.

1.heading: What we collect
1.body: Your Strava profile (name, photo), activities (distance, pace, heart rate, elevation) and your training feedback (RPE, notes). Nothing else.

2.heading: Why
2.body: Solely to build your adaptive coaching plan and show your progress. No advertising, no sale, no sharing with third parties.

3.heading: Where it lives
3.body: Activities and profile data live in our MongoDB database. Strava access tokens are encrypted and never leave the server.

4.heading: Your rights (GDPR)
4.body: Access, correct or erase your data anytime. Disconnect stops all collection; Settings → Delete my account permanently erases your athlete profile, activities and feedback.

5.heading: Retention
5.body: Data is kept while your account exists and deleted immediately when you erase it. Revoking Strava access stops future syncs.

1.heading: The service
1.body: PacePilot turns your Strava history into an adaptive running plan. A Strava account and connection are required to use it.

2.heading: Not medical advice
2.body: Training guidance is evidence-based but generic. It is not medical advice, diagnosis or treatment. Consult a professional for injuries or health conditions. Train at your own risk.

3.heading: Fair use
3.body: Connect only your own Strava account. Do not abuse sync or share sessions to scrape data.

4.heading: Availability
4.body: Provided as-is, without uptime guarantees. The service depends on Strava API availability and rate limits.

5.heading: Ending it
5.body: Disconnect anytime to stop collection, or erase everything via Settings → Delete my account.
